extracted.name: Hoagie Dip
extracted.description: This hoagie dip combines all your favorite sandwich tastes into a mouthwatering dip.
ingredient_lines: 12 hoagie rolls, torn into pieces for dipping
instruction_lines: Stir mayonnaise and oregano together in a medium bowl.

Tear American cheese, ham, and salami into small pieces; place into a large bowl. Stir in mayonnaise mixture, 1/2 cup at a time, until cheese and meats are well coated. Stir in onion, then stir in lettuce and tomatoes.
Serve with bread pieces for dipping.
